press_fit_interference.description: Requires vise or arbor press pressure. Permanently seats metal ball bearings, dowel pins, or bushings. Plastic elastically deforms to grip hardware.

snug_fit_transition.description: Parts slide together with light manual finger friction and maintain stationary position.

sliding_fit_close_running.description: Smooth gliding motion without mechanical binding or lateral slop.

free_fit_loose_running.description: Guarantees zero binding across layer-line thermal variance.

crush_ribs_specification.purpose: Prevents radial hoop stress cracking and perimeter layer delamination when pressing metal hardware into circular bores.
crush_ribs_specification.formula_openscad: module crush_rib_bore(dia, h, ribs=4, rib_t=0.2, rib_w=0.6) { difference() { children(); union() { cylinder(d=dia+0.05, h=h+0.2, center=true); for (i=[0:ribs-1]) rotate([0,0,i*360/ribs]) translate([dia/2 - rib_t/2, 0, 0]) cube([rib_t, rib_w, h+0.2], center=true); } } }

PLA.creep_resistance: Poor (viscoelastic cold creep; sags under sustained shelf/spring load)
PLA.annealing: Bake in convection oven at 60-80°C for 2h to induce semi-crystalline phase (HDT >100°C). Apply +1.8% X/Y scale compensation in CAD.

PETG.impact_resistance: High (Ductile; 2.7x Izod energy absorption over PLA)

TPU_95A.nozzle_recommendation: Direct-drive with 0.6mm or 0.8mm nozzle to prevent backpressure buckling

dfam_rules.wall_count_over_infill: 6 solid perimeters + 20% gyroid infill yields superior flexural, torsional, and impact strength compared to 2 perimeters + 100% rectilinear infill while saving 30% print time.
dfam_rules.stress_concentration_fillets: Sharp 90° internal corners act as stress risers and generate deposition voids. Mandatory internal fillet radius R >= 1.5mm - 3.0mm to eliminate micro-crack propagation along layer lines.
dfam_rules.anisotropy_management: FDM tensile strength along Z-axis is only 65-72% of XY injection molded baseline. Orient structural cantilever loads parallel to XY layer planes to put Z-axis in compression.
food_safe_3_step_protocol: 1. Stainless Steel Nozzle: Replace standard brass nozzles to prevent lead contamination from brass alloys.
2. Uncolored Natural Filament: Print exclusively with unpigmented raw PETG/PLA to avoid heavy-metal or toxic masterbatch chemical dyes.
3. Food-Grade Epoxy Seal: Apply FDA-compliant, BPA-free two-part epoxy resin to permanently seal microscopic FDM layer grooves against bacterial colonization.

orcaslicer_advanced_features.scarf_seams: Dynamically tapers extrusion flow rate and Z-height over a 20mm transition slope, eliminating visible Z-seam blobs on functional cylinders, pipes, and pressurized fluid adapters.
orcaslicer_advanced_features.sandwich_mode: Inner-Outer-Inner wall order securely anchors precarious steep overhang perimeters between two stable inner shells, preventing thermal curl-up on aggressive overhangs.
orcaslicer_advanced_features.pressure_advance_and_input_shaping: Eliminates high-speed 600mm/s CoreXY corner bulging and cancels motor resonance ringing via accelerometer resonance compensation.
